name: motopms-db-tests
description: Database and sync tests for MotoMonitor. Separate from the app so they never affect the APK.

scripts.test: npm run test:accounts && npm run test:friends && npm run test:nudges && npm run test:rls && npm run test:sync
scripts.test:sync: node sync/copy-lib.mjs && cd sync && node --import tsx --import ./register.mjs test.mts
